comments.rawMarkdown:
I’m Shubham, a Computer Engineering student from India, interested in AI/ML, LLMs, Agentic AI, and research-oriented projects.

I have hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB, Git/GitHub, and full-stack development. I’ve also been exploring LLM applications, RAG, multi-agent systems, model routing, and AI research, and I’m particularly interested in building something that is both technically strong and research-worthy for the Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track.

I’m looking to team up with people who are interested in:
🤖 Agentic AI / LLMs
🧠 Research & paper writing
🔬 Experimentation and evaluation
💻 Building a working prototype
📊 Data analysis / benchmarking

I can contribute on the development, system architecture, experimentation, documentation, and research side.

If you're looking to build a serious project and potentially turn it into a strong paper, feel free to DM me! 🚀

Let’s build something interesting with Gemma 4!

replies.rawMarkdown:
Hi Shubham! Best of luck with the Gemma 4 Developer Agent track. 

For research and benchmarking agentic decision-making on financial workflows without compliance risks, we published a zero-PII evaluation dataset and starter notebook:
https://www.kaggle.com/code/sabbah99/financial-agentic-ai-sft-starter-free-data

It covers multi-action traces and validation metrics that might help your team's experiments.

firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone,


I'm a Digital Business & Data Science student (Hamburg, Germany) looking to join or form a team for the Paper Track.



I've been building AI agent projects on my own (root-cause analysis and data-pipeline investigation agents), and I'm interested in evaluating Gemma 4 as an offline coding agent, specifically for real-world data/analytics bugs (pandas, SQL, dbt-style pipelines) rather than general software bugs — this could also target the Best New Resource prize with a new benchmark dataset.

What I can bring to a team:


Building evaluation harnesses and reproducible Kaggle notebooks
Constructing and verifying a bug/test benchmark
Hands-on experience building and testing AI agents


Looking for teammates strong in RL, fine-tuning, or academic paper writing to complement this. If you're working on something similar or want to team up, drop a comment or send an invite.


Looking forward to collaborating!
